title: Clinical Utility Pilot Of Thyroid GuidePx
official: Clinical Utility Pilot Of Thyroid GuidePx
summary: The purpose of this research study is learn about the effects of Thyroid GuidePx® on papillary thyroid cancer treatment recommendations when the test result is disclosed after surgery.

Inclusion Criteria:

disease who can potentially be treated with lobectomy will be recruited to the study. Lobectomy-candidate status is determined by the treating physician using standard institutional criteria (e.g., tumor 1-4 cm, cN0/Nx, no gross ETE). Patients may still undergo total thyroidectomy as part of shared decision-making.

Inclusion criteria:

* Patients aged 18 years or older at the time of enrollment
* English-speaking
* Bethesda V or VI cytology following FNA of a thyroid nodule (papillary thyroid cancer)
* Preoperative candidacy for lobectomy

  * Tumor 1 - 4 cm in size
  * No known nodal metastasis
  * No gross extrathyroidal extension (ETE) on ultrasound
* Any of the following intraoperative or surgeon-dependent variations are permitted:

  * Prophylactic ipsilateral central neck dissection performed at the surgeon's discretion
  * Therapeutic central neck dissection for unexpected central node metastases
  * Intraoperative conversion to total thyroidectomy (e.g., gross ETE, multiple large central nodes)
* Able to undergo intraoperative FNA collection for research testing

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prior thyroid operation
* Distant metastatic disease
* Personal history of thyroid cancer
* History of whole-body radiation exposure or radiation to the head and neck region
* Preoperatively known central or lateral lymph node metastasis
* Receipt of total thyroidectomy is not an exclusion if preoperative features otherwise meet lobectomy-candidate criteria

Patients remain eligible if unexpected central nodal disease is identified intraoperatively or if the surgeon elects to perform a prophylactic ipsilateral central neck dissection, as these scenarios are compatible with initial lobectomy candidacy at MD Anderson.
